releaseNotes: v1.2.0 -Added PTZ calibration support: calibratePtz (triggers pan/tilt recalibration) and checkPtzCalibrationStatus (reports Required/Running/Done via new ptzCalibrationStatus attribute) commands on the Reolink Camera driver, for PTZ-capable models like Trackmix and E1 Zoom. Non-PTZ cameras will simply return an error if these are used -- harmless, see in-app Tips page. Also includes v1.1.1 (fixed a polling bug causing duplicate stacked schedules that could trip Hubitat's excessive-hub-load protection) and v1.1.2 (expanded debug logging for token lifecycle and poll response/no-response transitions.
author: jdthomas24
